sectionContext.speaker: Blake Giunta
sectionContext.claim: Bayesian reasoners may begin with different subjective priors but should converge as shared evidence accumulates, and theism can be assessed in the same way.
sectionContext.warrant: Scientific experts can disagree from different priors despite shared information; explicit priors plus continued updating make those assumptions visible and allow convergence.
sectionContext.inference: One may start with any prior for theism and still reach rational confidence if enough favorable evidence accumulates, without a separate possibility criterion.
